courses.title: Data Analyst Masterclass - Get Job Ready in 10 Weeks
courses.description: Go from data novice to job-ready analyst in 8 weeks. Master SQL, Excel, and Python to solve real business problems and land your dream role in tech.
courses.prerequisites:
• No prior data experience is required
• Basic computer literacy and internet access
• Access to a computer with Microsoft Excel
• A passion for solving real-world problems
benefits: Live sessions on Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau
Real dashboards and analytics case studies for your portfolio
Standard track $1,497 — Career track $1,997 includes 1:1 job assistance (resume, referrals, mock interviews)
Lifetime access to recordings and resources

target_personas.description: Career switchers looking to break into the tech industry with no prior technical background.
Recent graduates wanting to add high-demand analytical skills to their resumes.
Small business owners aiming to use data to drive growth and operational efficiency.
Hobbyists and curious learners who enjoy uncovering patterns and solving puzzles.

course_weeks.description:

course_weeks.description:

course_weeks.title: Business Metrics & Data Decisions
course_weeks.description:
